item.title: GTA 6 is coming to Xbox One after all, through cloud streaming
item.description: Microsoft says Xbox One owners can stream GTA VI through Xbox Cloud Gaming from November 19 at 1am ET. You still have to buy the game.

item.title: GTA 6 preload is live: start times, 212 GB and how to make room
item.description: Digital GTA VI pre-orders can download now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and boxed copies follow on November 12. What to do before launch.

item.title: Those "leaked" GTA 6 cheat codes are GTA V's. Here's what we know
item.description: Viral posts claim GTA 6 cheat codes have leaked. The lists are GTA V's codes, and Rockstar has not confirmed any cheats for GTA VI.
